old_bullet: - Apply the necessary change, then run the checks required by its behavior and the project. Repair failures. Repeat passing checks when subsequent edits affect them or unresolved evidence requires it.
new_bullet: - Apply the necessary change with its required checks in one tool or shell call when they can run together safely; keep labeled results and each exit status. Use the results to decide the next action. Repair failures, and rerun checks affected by later edits or unresolved evidence. Do not add a separate artifact dump or repeat a successful check just to prepare the final report; retain source-backed checks needed to establish correctness.
